# pangolin_health_checks (Data Source)

Lists the health checks of the organization, newest first: the standalone ones (managed by `pangolin_health_check`) and the probes attached to targets (`standalone = false`, with the `resource_*` attributes set). All filters are optional and applied server-side.

> **Note:** Requires Pangolin Enterprise Edition (written against 1.24.0).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pangolin_health_checks" "all" {}

# Standalone checks that are currently failing.
data "pangolin_health_checks" "unhealthy" {
  health  = "unhealthy"
  enabled = true
}

output "unhealthy_standalone_checks" {
  value = [
    for hc in data.pangolin_health_checks.unhealthy.health_checks : hc.name if hc.standalone
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Keep only the enabled (`true`) or disabled (`false`) health checks.
- `health` (String) Keep only this health: `healthy`, `unhealthy` or `unknown`.
- `mode` (String) Keep only this probe mode: `http`, `tcp`, `snmp` or `ping`.
- `query` (String) Case-insensitive substring match on the name.
- `resource_id` (Number) Keep only the probes attached to a target of this resource.
- `site_id` (Number) Keep only the health checks run by this site.

### Read-Only

- `health_checks` (Attributes List) List of health checks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_checks))

### Nested Schema for `health_checks`

Read-Only:

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the probe runs.
- `follow_redirects` (Boolean) Whether redirects are followed.
- `headers` (Attributes List) Probe request headers - list of `{name, value}` objects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--health_checks--headers))
- `health` (String) `unknown`, `healthy` or `unhealthy`.
- `healthy_threshold` (Number) Successes required to turn healthy.
- `hostname` (String) Probed host.
- `id` (Number) Numeric health check ID.
- `interval` (Number) Interval in seconds while healthy.
- `method` (String) Probe HTTP method.
- `mode` (String) Probe mode.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `path` (String) Probed URL path.
- `port` (Number) Probed port.
- `resource_id` (Number) Resource of the target the probe is attached to (null when standalone).
- `resource_name` (String) Name of that resource.
- `resource_nice_id` (String) Nice ID of that resource.
- `scheme` (String) Probe scheme.
- `site_id` (Number) ID of the site running the probe.
- `site_name` (String) Name of the site running the probe.
- `site_nice_id` (String) Nice ID of the site running the probe.
- `standalone` (Boolean) `false` for a probe attached to a target.
- `status` (Number) Expected HTTP status code.
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds.
- `tls_server_name` (String) TLS SNI.
- `unhealthy_interval` (Number) Interval in seconds while unhealthy.
- `unhealthy_threshold` (Number) Failures required to turn unhealthy.
